messages:
reza: Noticed a subtle compatibility drift between runtime 7.2.0 and SDK 6.1.x during long-poll clients. Suggest we soft-unpin 7.2.0 for APAC tomorrow morning.

tara: Can you summarize the failure mode?

reza: Under long-poll, some clients see duplicated final tokens and then a stream close. Repro in staging: persist 50 streams, run for 120s -> ~0.6% duplication. Logs show duplicate flushes from kernel layer.

sdk-bot: Telemetry: header `x-sdk-ver` present in 71% APAC traffic. 6.1.x accounts for ~40% of that.

ops-kim: What's our mitigation palette? full rollback to 7.1.5, soft-unpin with predicate, or on-the-fly model-variant fallback?

reza: Options: 1) soft-unpin to 7.1.5 for APAC with canary 1%->10% 2) add routing rule to route long-poll requests to a compatibility pool running 7.1.5 3) patch 7.2.0 with a stream-de-dup fallback (fast patch).

pm-julie: Customer impact: long-poll used by several managed customers in APAC. If we exclude them from canary we must notify via CS.

oncall-lee: We should prefer option 2 (compatibility pool) to avoid flipping default for everyone. Lower blast radius.

tara: Good point. Do we have capacity to stand up a small compat pool?

ops-kim: Yes, we can reserve a 10-node pool for compat and route by request path header `x-connection:type=long-poll`. Will add predicate and pre-warm 7.1.5 bundle.

deploy-bot: Plan created: compat-pool-route-7.1.5-apac | window: 2026-02-14T01:00Z-03:00Z | canary: 0.5% -> 5% @15m | predicate: header('x-connection').equals('long-poll') and region == 'apac' | fallback: default runtime 7.2.0

reza: I'll instrument de-dup counters and add a short trace at stream flush points. If dup rate >0.2% on compat pool we abort.

ops-kim: Rollback runbook: 1) remove compatibility route PR 2) drain compat pool and deprovision nodes 3) revert deploybot rule if needed 4) alert oncall if dup rate >0.5% for 5m.

pm-julie: I'll prepare a CS note to managed customers who use long-poll in APAC, explaining the compat routing and expected minimal disruption.

deploy-bot: PR: github.com/redwood/deploy-rules/pull/924 -> adds `header('x-connection').equals('long-poll') && region=='apac'` predicate. Tests included.

oncall-lee: Approve the plan from oncall POV. Keep me in loop for >0.2% dup.

tara: Okay let's proceed with compat-pool approach. Reza + ops, please stand by for 01:00Z start. pm-julie please hold CS send until we confirm canary baseline is stable.

deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: start 2026-02-14T01:05Z | initial payload 0.5% | compat pool prewarmed with runtime 7.1.5. Manual expand at 01:25Z.

reza: post-start check in 10m: will report dup rate and trace samples.

ops-kim: preflight done: 7.1.5 images preloaded, routing rule in staging passing tests.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-02-14T01:05Z | payload 0.5% | predicate active.

reza: first 12m: dup rate 0.03% on compat pool, mainline 7.2.0 shows 0.58% for long-poll. Traces indicate kernel flush duplicate path present on 7.2.0 only.

oncall-lee: green to expand to 5% gradually.

pm-julie: CS note sent to affected managed customers at 01:30Z: "We've routed long-poll connections to a temporary compatibility pool to mitigate streaming duplication seen in runtime 7.2.0. No action needed on your side."

ops-kim: expanding to 5% now. Monitoring hooks active.

deploy-bot: expansion executed at 2026-02-14T01:32Z -> compat pool 5%. Monitoring will report in 10m.

reza: thanks team. Next: runtime team to triage duplication bug and propose patch for 7.2.1. We'll keep the compat pool until patch is validated.
